newsitem.title: USA: Sept U.S. gasoline pump prices creep up -- AAA.
newsitem.headline: Sept U.S. gasoline pump prices creep up -- AAA.

text.p: U.S. gasoline pump prices edged up a notch in September, halting a three-month slide, according to the American Automile Association (AAA).

In its September 17 Fuel Guage report, AAA said self-serve regular unleaded gasoline rose to $1.255 per gallon this month, up 0.2 cent from August. But the price was still 8.7 cents above year-ago levels.
Pump prices were highest in the West, where a gallon of fuel averaged $1.387, 12 cents above last year. In the Northeast, gasoline prices rose 1.7 cents from August to $1.273 per gallon, AAA said.
